title: FM-04: Denormal CPU Spikes
summary: Critical failure mode: subnormal floating-point values cause CPU spikes on silence.
description:
## Symptom

CPU spikes to 100% when processing silence or very quiet signals.

## Cause

Subnormal (denormal) floating-point values in:
- Feedback loops (reverbs, delays)
- Filter tails
- Any state that accumulates small values

## Fix

```cpp
void processBlock(juce::AudioBuffer<float>& buffer, juce::MidiBuffer&) override {
    juce::ScopedNoDenormals noDenormals;  // Always first line!
    // ... rest of processing
}
```

Additionally, add DC offset in feedback paths:

```cpp
// In feedback path
feedbackSample = feedbackSample * feedbackGain + 1e-18f;  // Tiny offset
```

## Prevention

- Always start processBlock with ScopedNoDenormals
- Add 1e-18 offset in feedback loops
- Test with 60 seconds of silence and monitor CPU

concepts.name: ScopedNoDenormals
concepts.description: JUCE RAII class that disables denormals on current thread
